title: glsl_tesscontrol
description: load a GLSL tessellation control shader

messages.description: shader ID, to be linked with [glsl_program]

arguments.description: tessellation control shader file to load

methods.description: load a tessellation control shader file

body: [glsl_tesscontrol] loads a GLSL tessellation control shader. Send the resulting shader ID to [glsl_program] to link it into a shader program.
